tasks.description: In docs/userguide/configuration.rst, add new `task_acks_on_failure` and `task_acks_on_timeout` setting entries (Default: None, falling back to task_acks_on_failure_or_timeout then True; only applies with task_acks_late), and mark `task_acks_on_failure_or_timeout` as deprecated in 6.0 (removal 7.0) pointing to the two new settings.

In docs/userguide/tasks.rst, document the new Task.acks_on_failure and Task.acks_on_timeout attributes (fallback to acks_on_failure_or_timeout, then True; requires acks_late) and note that Task.acks_on_failure_or_timeout is deprecated in 6.0 in favor of them.

Where are task_acks_late and related ack settings documented so new task_acks_on_failure/task_acks_on_timeout settings can be added consistently?
Is there a changelog or whatsnew section for 6.0 where deprecations are recorded?
